newsitem.title: CANADA: Brick buys Laker brands, sells stake. [CORRECTED 16:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brick buys Laker brands, sells stake. [CORRECTED 16:35 GMT]

text.p: Brick Brewing Co Ltd said on Monday that it has signed a letter of intent to acquire the rights to the Laker beer brands from Molson Breweries.
Molson Breweries will receive cash payments over a period of up to four years and take a maximum 19 percent stake in Brick when the deal closes, the Waterloo-based craft brewer said in a statement.
Molson Breweries is 40 percent-owned each by Molson Cos Ltd and Foster's Brewing Group Ltd and 20 percent by Philip Morris Cos' Miller Brewing unit.
The value of the cash payments was not disclosed. Upon closing of the deal, Molson will receive Brick common shares at a price of C$2.20 per share.

"The fact that Molson has elected to become an equity partner is a tremendous endorsement to Brick and a natural, given the way that our business relationship has been evolving," said president and founder Jim Brickman.
The beer brands to be acquired by Molson Breweries include Laker Lager, Laker Light, Laker Ice, Laker Strong and Laker Dry.
